subject: How do I connect my Samsung WindFree AC to SmartThings app?
emailBody:
Hi Support Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing in with a general query
regarding one of my registered products.

My details are as follows:
  Customer Name   : Shubham Sahu
  Customer ID     : CUST10001
  Email           : shubhh2003@gmail.com
  Phone           : +91-98765-43210
  City            : Dehradun, Uttarakhand

Product Details:
  Product Name    : Samsung Bespoke AI WindFree Air Conditioner
  Model Number    : AR18CXFAAWKNNA
  Serial Number   : A7WF20031KR
  Purchase Date   : 20 March 2023

Query:
I am trying to connect my Samsung Bespoke AI WindFree Air Conditioner to
the SmartThings app on my smartphone so that I can control it remotely.
However, I am not sure about the exact steps to complete the setup.

Could you please guide me on:
  1. How do I connect the AC to the SmartThings app step by step?
  2. Do I need to be on the same WiFi network during the setup process?
  3. Does the AC support both 2.4GHz and 5GHz WiFi bands?

I am not reporting any fault or defect — the unit is working fine. I just
need guidance on the app connectivity setup.

Thank you for your time and assistance.

Warm regards,
Shubham Sahu
Customer ID : CUST10001
Phone       : +91-98765-43210
Email       : shubhh2003@gmail.com

matchedFaq.question: How do I connect my Samsung Bespoke AI WindFree AC to SmartThings?
matchedFaq.answer: Download the SmartThings app on your phone. Turn on the AC and press and hold the WiFi button on the remote for 3 seconds. In SmartThings tap Add Device → Samsung → Air Conditioner → follow setup wizard. Ensure your phone and AC are on the same 2.4GHz WiFi network during setup.

subject: S-Pen Air Actions keep disconnecting on Galaxy S26 Ultra
emailBody:
Hi Support Team,

I am writing to report an issue with my new Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra
(Model: SM-S938B).

While the phone itself is working fine, I am having a frustrating problem
with the S-Pen. It writes on the screen perfectly, but the "Air Actions"
feature constantly disconnects. Whenever I take the pen out to use the
button as a camera remote or to control my music, the phone throws an
"S-Pen disconnected" error.

I keep putting it back into the phone to reconnect it, but the Bluetooth
connection drops again within 10 minutes.

Since the pen still writes, I feel like this might just be a software
glitch or a setting I need to change. Can you please provide me with the
